siteInfo.subtitle: Czech Declension Trainer
siteInfo.description: Quiz yourself on Czech declensions - you'll get a series of sentences with a missing word, along with a choice of its possible forms - choose the correct one!
siteInfo.subdescription: This is very much a work in progress; answers have been verified for accuracy, but all the possible answers might not always align with all of the given word's valid declensions.
